title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is an event analytics platform for builders who need answers from their data at their fingertips—no SQL required. When everyone in the organization can see and learn from the impact of their work on product, marketing, and company revenue metrics, they are poised to make better decisions.

Over 9,000 paid customers, including companies like Netflix, Pinterest, Sweetgreen, and Samsara, use Mixpanel to understand their customers and measure progress. Our commitment is to provide the most comprehensive and reliable analytics platform accessible and trusted by all.

Locations Considered

San Francisco Bay Area, San Diego, Los Angeles, Seattle, Chicago, or Austin.

About the Team

The Operational Finance Team is responsible for a variety of tasks that are instrumental in keeping the business running on a day-to-day basis. There are six teams within the Operational Finance Function each serve a specific purpose to the company: (1) Accounting and Accounts Payable - Accurately records all vendor related transactions and keeps our vendors paid, (2) AR Team - provisions all customers access to Mixpanel and ensure proper revenue recognition and records all customer payments and ensures we get paid on time, (3) Payroll - prepares payrolls for all employees world wide. (4) Deal Desk - facilitates in the contract review and execution of customer contracts and assists the sales team to accelerate the deal cycle. (5) Procurement - oversees and facilitates the source-to-pay process with an objective of efficiency and cost savings.

About the Role

Mixpanel is looking for someone to be the first tax hire, with the primary focus being indirect tax, with a heavy focus on international indirect tax. They should have strong experience with a variety of indirect and International tax operations and can drive process improvements. This person should work well independently, as well as have the ability to work well with stakeholders and communicate the benefits of tax initiatives. In this role, strong accounting, analytical, and research skills will be required, along with excellent written and oral communication skills. We are looking for an Indirect Tax Manager who will direct and manage multiple operations related to taxes while also participating in the preparation of recurring obligations. This role will manage specific indirect tax-related functions in addition to compliance-related activities and plan, manage, and develop overall aspects of the company's tax process. This role will report to the Corporate Controller.

Responsibilities

  • Facilitate and coordinate with outside tax consultants the preparation, review, and submission of all required company tax filings, including: Sales Tax, 1099, VAT/GST, withholding taxes, and other indirect taxes.
  • Manage and facilitate indirect tax-related audits and projects: preparing responses, creating schedules, reviewing memos, etc.
  • Develop and implement strategic tax planning for all necessary indirect and international taxes.
  • Plan for and develop the overall return calendar and coordinate timing and inputs with the tax team.
  • Maintain and prepare all general ledger accounts and oversee the preparation and recording of all required tax-related filings, journal entries, and reconciliations (includes Corporate Taxes).
  • Maintain effective control procedures over all aspects of the tax process.
  • Find and implement opportunities for process improvement in company tax procedures.
  • Monitor legislative and regulatory tax law developments, communicate the effects of these developments to management and the tax team, and create strategies to capitalize on changes to taxation legislation.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Extensive corporate tax knowledge, familiar with International Taxes, local and indirect taxes (both US and internationally)
  • Strong knowledge of tax code, compliance, and procedures for corporations.
  • Familiarity with Indirect taxes - U.S. and internationally.
  • Strong communication, organizational and interpersonal skills.
  • The Tax Manager must be proficient with the following software/tools: ◦ Strong skills and experience with Word, Excel.
  • Preferred candidates have a current CPA license and a master’s degree in an accounting/tax discipline.
  • We are looking for a candidate with 5+ years of experience in indirect tax manager or public accountant role.

#LI-Remote

Compensation

The amount listed below is the total target cash compensation (TTCC) and includes base compensation and variable compensation in the form of either a company bonus or commissions. Variable compensation type is determined by your role and level. In addition to the cash compensation provided, this position is also eligible for equity consideration and other benefits including medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage. You can view our benefits offerings here.
Our salary ranges are determined by role and level and are benchmarked to the SF Bay Area Technology data cut released by Radford, a global compensation database. The range displayed represents the minimum and maximum TTCC for new hire salaries for the position across all of our US locations. To stay on top of market conditions, we refresh our salary ranges twice a year so these ranges may change in the future. Within the range, individual pay is determined by experience, job-related skills, qualifications, and other factors. If you have questions about the specific range, your recruiter can share this information.

Mixpanel Compensation Range $169,200 — $206,800 USD

Benefits and Perks

  • Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care
  • Mental Wellness Benefit
  • Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays
  • Enhanced Parental Leave
  • Volunteer Time Off
  • Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break

*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Culture Values

  • Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.
  • Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drivepowerful outcomes.
  • One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.
  • Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.
  • Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.
  • Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

Quem Somos A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais : Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certos juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam : Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho :

  • Fornecer suporte técnico direto aos clientes focados na solução de Comércio Exterior (OSGT - OneSource Global Trade);
  • Utilizar a linguagem PL / SQL como base principal para todas as análises e investigações, criação de scripts para pequenas rotinas de manutenção;
  • Realizar investigações técnicas (debug) em PL / SQL com banco de dados ORACLE;
  • Atuar diretamente no monitoramento e troubleshooting das Integrações entre a OSGT;
  • Prestar atendimento ao cliente via telefone e / ou Teams, solucionando dúvidas e eventuais problemas da versão de forma eficaz;
  • Trabalhar com interação direta com todos os Módulos da OSGT (Importação, Exportação, Regimes Especiais, Drawback, etc);
  • Atuar em conjunto com diferentes departamentos para garantir a integração e funcionamento adequado dos sistemas;

Criar e manter documentação técnica detalhada sobre os processos e integrações realizadas

Analisar e documentar toda da análise técnica e funcional realizada para compartilhamento aos times de desenvolvimento.

O que você precisa ter :

  • Experiência como analista de suporte ao sistema OSGT (ONESOURCE Global Trade), nos módulos de Import, Export, Cambio Import e Cambio Export;
  • Experiência em PL / SQL para suporte técnico (debug de objetos base).

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.
